title: PDF retrieval, access information and institutional retries
description: Retrieve supported provider-supplied PDFs for saved OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar papers, prefer reported open copies, discover exact-DOI alternatives, and show observed access barriers with campus/VPN retry and browser/upload fallback. Reuse durable ingestion with UUID deduplication, lease fencing and document-version provenance. Browser institutional sessions are not inherited by the backend.
acceptance_criteria: Given either provider with a supported PDF, when retrieval is requested, then original storage and page-grounded ingestion complete on the same saved paper.
Given no Semantic Scholar open PDF and an exact DOI alternative, when discovery runs, then the other provider copy is used without a duplicate paper or manual metadata overwrite.

Given authentication, generic blocking, HTML, rate limiting or missing links, when retrieval stops, then the observed reason and useful retry/browser/upload actions are shown without an unsupported paywall claim.
Given access denial, when a fresh UUID retries after the network permits access, then retrieval succeeds while the old UUID still replays its original job.

Given duplicate deliveries, crash recovery, stale leases or concurrent upload, when retrieval continues, then document/ingest state is deduplicated and newer attachments and historical citations are preserved.
Given unsafe destinations, redirect/DNS changes, oversized bytes or timeouts, when downloading is attempted, then defined bounds and public-destination checks are enforced.
Given the local-model WIP base, when verification runs, then its model/readiness workflows and the core paper workflows remain covered in isolated test services.
Given every behavior change, when implementation proceeds, then an actual failing behavior assertion precedes production code and relevant green regressions are recorded.
test_cases: Provider location/OA/license/version normalization, old snapshots, exact DOI discovery, identity conflict and provider-error fallback.
Real isolated PostgreSQL/MinIO request replay, concurrent coalescing, attempt fencing, migration preservation and paper-linked jobs.
DNS pinning/TLS hostname, redirect validation, private/mixed addresses, size/decompression/time bounds and honest HTTP outcome classification.
Denial then success, stable attachment checkpoint recovery, duplicate delivery, lease loss, storage recovery and manual-upload race.
RTL and Playwright Get/Find PDF, institutional/browser guidance, navigation recovery, extraction gating, source versions and mobile/keyboard behavior.
Fresh full regression, contract drift, one Alembic head, current upstream integration and restart persistence; live university entitlement remains a separate actual-network check.
verification: Implementation authorized; feat/fulltext-access incorporates managed-ollama through 459290d. Isolated baseline: backend 365 passed, frontend 375 passed with strict tsc/ESLint and build. Task 1: 9 metadata/DOI reds, 3 discovery reds and 1 ranking red; full backend now 378 passed in 43.47s. Remaining tasks are in progress. Task 2 full backend: 391 passed; migration 0006 preserves local-model state and UUID/access-attempt contracts are implemented.
